UREASON FOR REFERRALU: Diagnostic test for Rigid Spine Muscular Dystrophy (RSMD) / Multiminicore disease.

UTEST

Screen for mutations in the Selenoprotein N1 (SEPN1) gene by DNA sequencing.

URESULTS

No mutation detected

USUMMARYU 

The clinical diagnosis of a SEPN1-related muscular dystrophy is NOT confirmed.

UNotes
Recessive mutations in the Selenoprotein N1 gene (SEPN1) are associated with rigid spine muscular dystrophy (RSMD) and the classic form of multiminicore disease.  The entire coding region of the SEPN1 gene including splice sites has been screened for mutations by fluorescent Sanger DNA sequencing, which detects >99% of point mutations and microlesions.
Please note: 1. Any DNA remaining after completion of the above tests is stored for potential use in the future.    2.  The above results and interpretations assume that (a) samples received by the laboratory are correctly identified, (b) family relationships given by consultands are true, and (c) the clinical diagnosis is as stated.   3. In order to avoid error and/or misinterpretation, transcription of all or part of this report is inadvisable.
